description: This file contains shell functions related to platform-specific upgrade procedures for embedded devices, including verifying image compatibility, copying configuration files, and performing disk upgrades.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the image's partition layout matches the current device, and aborts if there is a change.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration to the mounted partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs disk upgrade procedures, including writing bootloader, partitions, and UUIDs.
